prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: single pose reference for Ember Energy Station C02 collection animation; NOT a spritesheet.
Input image 1 is the approved idle robot and identity/stance reference. Input image 2 is the repaired v002 four-direction animation atlas and structure reference.
Primary request: produce exactly ONE full-body pose of this same compact maintenance robot facing toward the bottom of screen, front facing. Collection phase 0: slightly raise the existing brass tool wrist and lean the forearm inward, ready to sample a machine.
Keep helmet, face plate/back plate, chest armor, legs, boots and foot positions unchanged. The tool stays attached to its original anatomical hand; left and right are individually designed, never mirrored. Body remains upright, neither walking nor kneeling. Compact ceramic armor, blue-grey metal joints, small brass coupling tool; no weapon.
Hand-sorted pixel-art blocks, top-down three-quarter orthographic game view, subtle light from upper left; material three/four shade steps. Palette references #101820 #182631 #2B3E4B #4D6470 #829BA3 #BECBC4 #7B4D35 #B77C4B #E2B77A #566B78 #ECE9D8. The lamp is neutral dark steel. Do not bake cyan/orange/red status emission.
Composition: single centered robot, full transparent portrait canvas and generous empty margins. Designed for final native 64x96 pixels, body within 40x64, fixed virtual ground point (32,80). This is a pose guide later reconstructed with editable native parts, not a direct rescale target.
Constraints: true transparent background, no shadow, no ground, no sparks, no halo, no text, no watermark, no extra object, no detached pixels/limbs. Preserve the same height and tiny proportions.
